```
The following exceptions occured during the cf checker (possibly indicate compliance checker issues):
cf.check_data_types: NetCDF: Attribute not found
```

The issue is caused by an incorrect attribute access in `compliance_checker/cf/cf.py`. In the `CFBaseCheck.check_data_types` method, the code attempts to access `v.datatype` on a NetCDF4 variable object. As noted in the issue, the correct attribute name for a `netCDF4.Variable` object is `v.dtype`.

To resolve this, the following changes are required in `compliance_checker/cf/cf.py`:

1. In `compliance_checker/cf/cf.py::CFBaseCheck.check_data_types`, update line 271 to use `v.dtype` instead of `v.datatype`.
2. In `compliance_checker/cf/cf.py::CFBaseCheck.check_data_types`, update line 282 to use `v.dtype` instead of `v.datatype` when constructing the failure message.
